# Board Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before changing this repository.

- Preserve the static fixture-only preview boundary.
- Run `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` for relevant changes.
- Add or update browser coverage for visible behavior and keyboard interaction.
- Do not add credentials to source, fixtures, preview environments, or logs.
